articles.summary: Most lenders evaluate borrower risk using data that's already weeks or months old. Credit reports, financial statements, and periodic reviews capture a moment in time—but borrowers' financial situations shift constantly, and static snapshots miss the signals that matter most.
articles.title: Borrower Health Data and What Lenders Are Missing in 2026

articles.summary: Business financing has become increasingly specialized. Today's borrowers are looking for everything from SBA loans and equipment financing to working capital loans, and other forms of business financing. While demand for capital remains healthy, finding the right lender for each borrower has become more challenging.
articles.title: Building the Right Lender Network: The Importance for Business Loan Brokers

articles.summary: Multi-lender orchestration is a centralized, API-driven approach that connects borrowers to a network of lending partners through a single integration—replacing the fragmented process of building and maintaining separate connections to each lender.
articles.title: Why Multi-Lender Orchestration Is Becoming Core Lending Infrastructure

articles.summary: Demand for business financing continues to remain strong as small businesses seek funding for working capital, equipment purchases, expansion, acquisitions, and everyday operations. While there is no shortage of borrowers looking for capital, many business loan brokers face a different challenge: finding enough lending partners to serve those borrowers effectively.
articles.title: Why Lender Access Matters for Business Loan Brokers

articles.summary: A credit score tells you how a borrower performed six months ago. Borrower health data tells you how they're performing right now—cash flow patterns, revenue trends, repayment activity across multiple lenders, and early fraud signals that traditional reports miss entirely.
articles.title: Real-Time Borrower Health Data and the Future of Credit Monitoring

articles.summary: Credit decisioning is the process lenders use to evaluate whether a borrower qualifies for financing, what terms to offer, and how much risk the loan represents. When automated, this process replaces manual review with technology-driven workflows that pull data, apply scoring models, and return decisions in seconds rather than days.
articles.title: A Practical Guide to Automated Credit Decisioning

articles.summary: SMB underwriting relies on a complex mix of traditional business financials, personal credit histories, and real-time cash flow analysis—and there's no single commercial equivalent to a consumer FICO score to simplify the process. That complexity is exactly why lenders who get their data strategy right pull ahead, while those who don't watch deals slip away to faster competitors.
articles.title: How to Build a Stronger SMB Underwriting Data Strategy in 2026

articles.summary: Loan servicing teams spend hours on tasks that follow predictable patterns—chasing documents, sending payment reminders, updating borrower records. AI handles these workflows automatically, freeing your team to focus on exceptions and relationships that actually require human judgment.
articles.title: AI for Loan Servicing: A Lender's Roadmap to Smarter Automation

articles.summary: Subscription revenue has a ceiling. For SaaS platforms serving SMBs, that ceiling arrives faster than most founders expect—customer acquisition costs climb, expansion revenue plateaus, and the path to profitability narrows.
articles.title: Embedded Lending and SaaS Monetization: How to Turn Credit Into a Revenue Stream
